rules.name: Staged scheduling maintenance has no application dependency
Installed child lifetime uses only the release identity contract
Owned request models validate without application services
Intake has no application or provider dependency
Primitives stay independent
Pure CVE adapters do not acquire or persist
Acquisition cannot reach case workflow
Standalone attribution cannot import application modules
Shared UI helpers stay below application workflow
Shared layout and rendering control stay within UI
Shared renderers receive operation control from callers
Observatory does not import intake or source jobs
Repositories never coordinate workflow
Workspace infrastructure stays below workflow
Review projection cannot invoke review commands
Case records do not import lifecycle facades
Content snapshot does not depend on mutation services
Source repository is independent of case records
Reference changes use a case-owned read interface
Contact discovery does not mutate casework
Reports acquisition module remains independent
Aegis remains independent
Approval evidence cannot coordinate workflow
Runtime tools stay independent of consuming workflows
